text:
maria: opened a quick docs PR that tries to consolidate guidance for 429s, timeouts, and context-trim surprises. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1510
kevin: nice. please differentiate Hosted vs Dedicated burst behavior and mention "retry-after" nuances.
sam: add small code examples for parsing Retry-After (js + py) and a one-liner about when to stop retrying (sustained vs transient).
jordan: runtime sometimes trims contexts and returns 200 with a warning field — include that example so callers don't assume success means full input used.
maria: added mapping: rate-limit -> 429; runtime abort -> 504; context-trim -> 200 w/ "context_trimmed": true. added JS/Python snippets and a short backoff flow.
docs-bot: checklist PR 1510: linkcheck, snippet-lint, SDK cross-ref; assign @kevin for review.
kevin: LGTM with one phrasing tweak on Dedicated burst line.
maria: will merge after tweak and will ping support to surface to customers if confusion arises. :rocket:
